summary.constantValue: How do I apply for a job at Chipotle?

text.constantValue: Look for the Careers section on Chipotle.com to search for open roles and apply online.

summary.constantValue: Why am I receiving an error message when I try to join Chipotle Rewards?

text.constantValue: Check the information you entered and follow any instructions in the error message. Visit Chipotle Rewards for program information.

summary.constantValue: Where can I find information regarding Chipotle's food and diet not mentioned on the Allergen Page?
